about_the_game:
EchoLink: Your Simultaneous Interpretation Partner

EchoLink is an innovative language learning and real-time translation software. More than just a simple translation tool, it's your essential partner for exploring new languages and cross-cultural content.

Whether you're watching a foreign film without subtitles, listening to a podcast in another language, or playing a foreign game without language support, EchoLink provides powerful assistance. It uses advanced technology to instantly translate the foreign language in videos and audio into a language you can understand, allowing you to immerse yourself in the content without barriers.

EchoLink's Powerful Features

  • Real-time Voice Translation: Whether it's movie dialogue or podcast content, EchoLink provides accurate interpretation as you listen.

  • Contextual Translation: Going beyond word-for-word literal translations, EchoLink provides more natural and fluid translations based on context, so you can easily understand the speaker's intent.

  • Multi-Scenario Application: From online courses and YouTube videos to Netflix series and various video games, EchoLink seamlessly integrates to provide instant translation services.

EchoLink turns language barriers into learning opportunities, allowing you to naturally improve your language skills while enjoying the content. It's a tool that brings the world to you, enabling you to deeply connect with different cultures anytime, anywhere.

Supported Languages Statement

Due to technical limitations, the software currently supports translation for the following language pairs only:

  • Chinese ↔ English, Japanese, Korean

  • English ↔ Chinese, Japanese, Korean

  • Japanese, Korean, Cantonese, German, French, Russian, Italian, Spanish → Chinese, English

We are continuously working to upgrade our technology and may offer support for more languages in the future. Please stay tuned for official updates.

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 2200G
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060or RTX 4070（At least 6GB VRAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060or RTX 4070（At least 12GB VRAM
